Going round, revolving; traversing, travelling or wandering over, or through, or in (used as last member of compounds, e.g. jahān-gard , 'One who has travelled over or around the world); — s.f. To make dusty, to dirty (clothes, &c.); to make dim, to dim, overshadow, cast a gloom over; to eclipse: — gard honā , v.n. To be or become dust: — to be worthless or good-for-nothing; to be as dust, to be easily removed or overcome, to be practicable or easy (e.g. měḥnat-ke āge sab gard hai ). 3) گردا gardā
